text:
miriam: Heads-up — platform team wants to flip the internal routing proxy to v2 next week. This will change the header handshake and how quotas are attributed. Need SDK compatibility plan.

jon: Noted. v2 adds an explicit route-affinity token and slightly different sampling semantics. Main risk is older SDKs that only send X-RouteHint.

kevin: Can you paste the header example? I want to see how bad the mismatch is.

miriam: Sure — current header: `X-RouteHint: model=a,b;region=us`

miriam: v2 wants: `X-Route-Routing: v2;affinity=pool-3;trace=opt-in` and optionally `X-Quota-Center: cost-center=12345`

alicia: So SDKs that only preserve `X-RouteHint` will be routed by compatibility fallback, but quota attribution will be lost unless we add a mapping.

kevin: That mapping is the trick. We could map `X-RouteHint` -> `X-Route-Routing: v2;affinity=<derived>` in the SDK shim, but deriving affinity reliably is hard.

jon: Platform could add a passthrough that, when it sees `X-RouteHint` and no `X-Route-Routing`, rewrites to v2-compatible form for a limited rollout window. Would be a short-lived compatibility layer.

kevin: I prefer SDK-side shim so we don't have server-side tech debt. But shipping faster is priority — maybe both? server passthrough for canary, SDK patch for stable.

miriam: Timeline: platform wants to start canary 48h after next prod deploy (tentatively Tue). We need at least a non-breaking SDK patch and docs before that.

alicia: For the patch: add header negotiation code that sends `X-Route-Routing: v2;affinity=auto` when server advertises `Routing-Version: v2` in response. Pseudocode: 

```
# on init
if server_caps.contains("routing:v2"):
  headers["X-Route-Routing"] = "v2;affinity=auto"
else:
  headers["X-RouteHint"] = existing_hint
```

kevin: That looks fine. But older servers won't advertise capability, so SDK should fall back to current behavior. Also add telemetry event when we switch to v2 so customers see migration.

miriam: Also need quota attribution: platform can accept `X-Client-CostCenter` as a fallback header for older SDKs — but we should prefer `X-Quota-Center` when available.

jon: We'll add server-side support: if `X-RouteHint` present and no `X-Quota-Center`, we try to map known prefixes to cost centers (best-effort). We'll emit a warning metric for unmapped ones.

kevin: SDK PR plan: 1) add header negotiation + opt-in env var `REDWOOD_ENABLE_ROUTING_V2` 2) emit telemetry `sdk.routing.v2_usage` 3) release patch to Py/TS/Go. Keep default off until server signals `Routing-Version`.

alicia: UX note: Console rollout tile needs a clear indicator: % requests routed via v2, % with quota attributed, and top unmapped hints. We'll wire `routing.migration` metrics from platform.

miriam: Agree. Product wants a canary flag toggle in the Console to flip passthrough on/off per region. That's coming from infra.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: platform/proxy v2 -> canary (region: us-west) @ 2026-04-02T02:00Z :robot_face: 

jon: Can we make canary 5% first? Also auto-roll back on error-rate > 0.5% or increase in 5xxs.

alicia: Yes. Also we need to coordinate SDK releases timing: Py/TS/Go need to land within 24h of canary start or else we risk muddled telemetry.

kevin: I'll open the three PRs today and tag people for quick reviews. PR will include: migration docs, sample code snippet for header negotiation, and a short CLI env var note.

miriam: Can someone draft the user-facing Console copy for the flag? Quick blurb: 

"Enable Routing Proxy v2 passthrough: when enabled, the Console will route legacy SDK headers through platform compatibility mode to preserve routing while you upgrade clients."

jon: Add a small tooltip: "If possible, update SDKs to send X-Route-Routing and X-Quota-Center for best quota attribution."

kevin: Will do. One more question: metrics retention — platform will keep migration metrics for 90d; is that enough for some of enterprise customers?

miriam: Product asked for 180d for key customers. We'll keep 90d default and offer 180d as a console add-on.

alicia: I'll add a short checklist in the rollout doc: canary %, SDK PRs merged, console tile wired, metrics alert thresholds, rollback criteria.

miriam: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll file a short runbook and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: runbook created: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/routing-proxy-v2-canary (access: eng,devex,platform) :page_facing_up:
